text_block_list.name: Furioso
choice_data_list:
1st place! You could only pull this off 
because it's you!

1st place! You achieved this precisely 
because it's you!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happened, you never gave up 
and kept fighting. You stayed by my side 
from Funabashi all the way to here without 
quitting.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It is because I was with you that I was 
able to come this far.
choice_data_list:
Thank you. But the one who worked so hard 
in the race was—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then how about this? We praise each 
other... and hold a victory party.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi Bakudan and Sauce Ramen. Let's 
recharge our energy and seize victory next 
time, too.
choice_data_list:
We've definitely got to win the next one 
too.

We've definitely got to win the next one 
too, right?

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
With the stomach of a Funabashi local, I 
shall devour every single dish you throw 
at me!
choice_data_list: P-Please go easy on my wallet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we revved our engines toward the 
next race.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To show the kids in Funabashi the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To prove that Funabashi won't lose to the 
JRA.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, it's not a victory party 
anymore, but a 'rallying meeting.'"
